messages.content: What is the meaning of the word indolent I ND OL ENT

message.content:
**Indolent** means **lazy**, **inactive**, or **showing little effort**.[1][3][4]

It can also describe something in medicine that is **slow to develop** or **causes little pain**, such as an indolent ulcer or indolent cancer.[1][4][6]
